# Analytical psychology

Jung’s symbolic history and Pauli’s dream/commentary retain separate authors and source passages. Modern psychological production remains distinct from the many regions whose images Jung interprets and from Pauli’s dream scene. Aion’s historical/aeonic interpretation is distinct from individual psychic sequence. Pauli’s egg sequence retains its specific letter and appendix dating witnesses.
